subject.title: [Feature]: Discord: Re-process edited user messages (MESSAGE_UPDATE event)

question: Should Discord edited-message reprocessing land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 as default plugin behavior, as an opt-in edit config surface, or as a split edit-only change separate from delete-to-cancel?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but config/default semantics and whether to bundle delete-to-cancel are product and upgrade-safety choices that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
options.body: Use the open PR or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

options.title: Require opt-in edit config
options.body: Implement `handleEdits` and edit debounce as disabled-by-default Discord config, matching this issue's compatibility proposal at the cost of new config surface.

options.title: Split delete-to-cancel
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and keep delete-to-cancel on the broader lifecycle tracker if cancellation semantics are not ready.

recommendation.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open PR or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest prior review context and recent Discord monitor/gateway history for the product-semantics decision.
